utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, the repair drive? I've heard bits about it. Are people bringing in all sorts of things?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I saw folks hauling in old toasters and lamps. Seems like anything that's broken is welcome.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's sounds neat! Do they actually fix everything on the spot, or do you leave it and pick it up later?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Opal, are you still planning to help with the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I'm planning to be there. It's Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM at the community center on 5th Street, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's right! I'll see you there. Thanks for helping out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Noah, I've got some wrenches and screwdrivers ready for the repair drive. Need anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that's great Gus. I think we're good on tools, but I might need to check my list again.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Alright, just let me know if you need any of mine. I can bring them over anytime.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! That's this Saturday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, Saturday at the community center. Cleo helps keep inventory of parts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Cleo? Oh right, the one with the organized shed. Glad she's on top of things.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Just finishing the supply tally for Rosa's list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You sure you got everything she asked for?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Almost, just need to double-check the wood glue count.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I've been telling everyone about the repair drive, Ira—should be a great turnout!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Glad to hear it! I've been spreading the word too—everyone's excited to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's wonderful! I think we'll have a full crew, maybe even some extra hands from the next block over.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got Rosa's list?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I have it right here. Let me double-check we didn't miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Cross-check with what we already have.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, just a reminder the repair drive is this Saturday from 10 to 4 at the community center on 5th Street. Are you planning to come?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks Jules. Let me just confirm—that's the one at the community center on 5th Street, right? And it's 10 to 4?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, that's right! 5th Street community center, 10 AM to 4 PM this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Rey! Thanks for coming by to talk about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, Rosa. I was wondering how I could help out. What do you need?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Well, we could really use someone to help coordinate the sign-ups—would you be up for that?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey there! Did you hear about the repair drive happening this weekend? They're fixing up the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, I might have heard something... I'm not sure I can make it, but thanks for letting me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, but it's gonna be fun! They have snacks and it's a great way to meet folks. Sure you can't spare an hour?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Eli, what skills are you bringing to the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can handle basic carpentry and fix squeaky doors, but I'll leave the heavy tools to Gus.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, we'll put you on the furniture and door repairs. Can you start at 10?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Sam, just confirming I'll drop off my stuff this afternoon. Where should I leave it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You can leave it in the garage on the workbench. I'll make sure everything gets sorted.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Okay, perfect. I'll drop it off in the garage on the workbench.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I've been telling everyone about the repair drive—lots of folks are excited to help out!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure people are actually excited, or just being polite?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, trust me, these are genuine smiles! I've seen their faces light up when I mention fixing up the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, have you heard how Rey's tool gathering is going?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: The repair drive is this Saturday at the community center. Cleo's keeping inventory of parts.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good to know about Cleo handling inventory. Are Daria and Rey still collecting tools for it?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, so Gus is bringing the tools. That should cover what we need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, sounds like we're all set then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, I'll be there at 9 sharp then.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What is this repair drive about? I want to make sure I understand the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's a community event where we fix broken items for free—like electronics, clothing, small appliances. We're collecting items next week at the school.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Should I bring my own tools, or will tools be provided at the event?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Bo, I heard about the repair drive from a neighbor. When's the next one?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I'm not sure about the next one. I just signed up to drop off my old stuff.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I see. I thought it was a hands-on event where we fix things together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, are you planning to stop by the repair drive on Saturday? It's at the community center on 5th Street from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I might come by a bit later, but I'll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, no rush! We'll have plenty of hands-on projects for you when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that... didn't quite catch all the details though.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Well, I hope they have a clear schedule planned out, otherwise it could be a real hassle for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, a schedule would be good. I'd hate to miss it if they show up when I'm not around.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM at the community center on 5th Street.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. Did Rosa share her supply list yet?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven't seen Rosa's list yet. Maybe check with Sam or Jules?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: A repair drive? I, uh, I might have some tools I could lend.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That's great, Uli! I can help you organize them and set up a schedule for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, a schedule sounds good. I'll bring them over Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mina, did you hear about the repair drive happening this Saturday? I heard they're fixing up old appliances for free!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, I'm organizing it. We need volunteers, you in?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely! I'd love to help out. What time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hey Cleo! The repair drive is this Saturday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, it's this Saturday! I'm actually making a list of what we still need. Do you have any spare tools?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, I think I have a hammer somewhere... maybe a wrench? Let me check my garage.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, I heard about the repair drive. I've got wrenches and screwdrivers ready to lend if needed!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus! That's really helpful. I'll add you to the list of volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, just let me know when you need them and I'll bring them over.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
